line: A phone loses signal when held by the corner; taken apart, its metal frame turns out to be the antenna, cut into pieces your hand can bridge.
line_cn: 一部手机握住底角就掉信号；拆开才发现金属边框就是天线，被切成几段，手一握就把缝连上了。

camera.expresses: the object built from a cut
camera.serves: an opening; introducing a new part
where something goes wrong; the one part that matters
revealing what the path ends in

camera.move: Tip-over plus crane up while layers lift
camera.serves: explaining an inside; a structure overview
a signal, a current, a flow

camera.move: Dive into a gap until a material fills the frame
camera.serves: a slit, a vent, a seam, a channel

camera.move: Locked top-down with a magnifier inset
Pull back with a slow orbit
camera.serves: a last statement; an end card

transitions: When a cut is needed, it happens through a shape: push into a part until its material fills the frame, then open a circle at the same point in the next shot;
Cuts and transitions fall between narration sentences or on a natural pause, never in the middle of a word.
No fades, no wipes from outside the medium, no hard cuts between unrelated angles.
labels: Two families, both licence-free: a technical grotesque for names and titles (IBM Plex Sans SemiBold in our demo, uppercase names with +1.4 px tracking) and its monospaced sibling for specs, units and footnotes (IBM Plex Mono). Chinese in a matching sans (Noto Sans SC), on screen at ≥ 34 px.
Roles: titles 54–64 px with one accent word; part names 21 px; spec lines 15 px mono; footnotes 12 px mono with wide tracking; data labels on rulers 20–26 px mono.

Label anatomy: anchor dot on the part → a straight leader → the name → at most one spec line in mono (drop the spec when the label cannot stay long enough to read it). A label appears only when its part is the subject and wipes out before the camera leaves it.
Appearance: text only ever writes on left to right and wipes off left to right, like a plotter. No fades, no bounces, no shadows or outlines on type.
motion: 24 fps on ones, everything deterministic. The camera and parts move smoothly; nothing boils.

Explosion: layers lift one by one on the beat, fast start and a long settle with a tiny overshoot (about 2.5 %); assembly guides (dashed grey lines) grow while they lift. Closing reverses it, bottom first, each layer landing with a small click.
The accent travels along the path at a steady speed, with a slightly lighter head, then floods the end part outward from its feed point; turning it off drains it back the same way.
Labels and dimension lines draw in over 0.3–0.6 s; dimension lines grow from their middle, then arrowheads land, then the number.

native_moves.name: Section sweep
native_moves.does: A clipping plane travels along the object, the cut face hatched, while the camera turns it in.
native_moves.fits: revealing an engine block; showing the layers of a road; opening a heart valve model.

native_moves.name: Lift on the beat
native_moves.does: Layers separate one per eighth note with growing dashed guides, labels landing as each settles.
native_moves.fits: a laptop's internals; the strata of a glacier core; a building's floors.

native_moves.name: The one-colour path
native_moves.does: A pulse at the source, the accent travels along the real route and floods its end; later it can drain and relight elsewhere.
native_moves.fits: power from a socket to a motor; air through a heat pump; a nerve signal to a muscle.

native_moves.name: Dive through a gap
native_moves.does: The camera pushes into a slit or vent until the hatched material fills the frame, then a circle opens into the next view.
native_moves.fits: the grille of a speaker; a crack in a dam; the gap of a disk brake.

native_moves.name: Magnifier cross-section
native_moves.does: A circle inset re-renders the same model from a new camera with a cut through it, linked to its spot by a dashed line.
native_moves.fits: a weld seam; the layers of a solar cell; the gasket in a tap.

native_moves.name: Ruler at model scale
native_moves.does: A measurement (a wavelength, a tolerance, a speed per second) is drawn as a ruler projected in the model's own millimetres beside the part, so the comparison is literal.
native_moves.fits: a raindrop against a sensor pixel; tyre tread against a legal minimum; a cable bend radius.

native_moves.name: Title block
native_moves.does: An engineering drawing's title block, ruled cell by cell, carries the title and credits.
native_moves.fits: an end card; a chapter card; a spec summary.

score.note: tuned mallets and plucks, never orchestral swells or drums
